scope: Public primary sources; no signed-in account or private data accessed.

sources.title: Agent Skills specification
sources.use: Frontmatter, portable directory format and progressive disclosure; no runtime authorization implied.

sources.title: Agent Skills creator best practices
sources.use: Ground instructions in actual project workflows; use focused references and executable checks.

sources.title: MCP 2026-07-28 tools
sources.use: Typed tool schemas, content and structured results, deterministic discovery and annotations.

sources.title: MCP security best practices
sources.use: Scope, handle ownership, local server exposure and untrusted URL risks.

sources.title: MCP 2026-07-28 release
sources.use: Stateless protocol does not remove application handles; extensions and compatibility require explicit negotiation.

sources.title: About Gemini models
sources.use: Models, reasoning levels, auto-selection and plan-dependent availability; refresh per account.

sources.title: Generate and edit images
sources.use: Multiple image references and separate Pro regeneration flow; first-pass Pro selection is not redo.

sources.title: Generate videos
sources.use: Native video page, mixed references, editing and account-dependent controls.

sources.title: Generate music
sources.use: Native music options, reference context and audio/video downloads.

sources.title: Upload and analyze files
sources.use: File, repository and native attachment entry points; input limits depend on availability.

sources.title: Use Deep Research
sources.use: Plan review, source choices, report retrieval and export are separate phases.

sources.title: Canvas docs, apps and other artifacts
sources.use: Native artifact kinds, direct versus generative edits, version controls and transformations.

sources.title: Generate Audio Overviews
sources.use: Audio deliverables from selected materials and reports, not merely podcast scripts.

sources.title: Quizzes, flashcards and practice tests
sources.use: Learning artifacts require their own typed object and completion evidence.

sources.title: Find and manage recent chats
sources.use: Chat discovery and management surface; does not guarantee complete backend pagination.

sources.title: Organize projects with notebooks
sources.use: Notebook/source/member workflows and current connected-notebook naming; IDs require verification.

sources.title: Create and manage skills
sources.use: Native Skill bundles, files, toggles, import/export and omitted live references.

sources.title: Gems transition to skills
sources.use: Personal-account transition starts November 2026; detect rollout and preserve legacy mappings.

sources.title: Tasks and workflows
sources.use: Native task execution and generated files; external actions have separate permission implications.

sources.title: Find and manage tasks
sources.use: Task progress and thread organization; thread deletion and provider cancellation differ.

sources.title: Schedules for tasks
sources.use: Time/event triggers and schedule management are distinct from legacy scheduled chats.

sources.title: Share chats
sources.use: Sharing creates public exposure; links and revocation need explicit scope.

sources.title: Memory summary
sources.use: Read/edit/delete memory summary has regional and account constraints.

sources.title: Saved information and response customization
sources.use: Personalization settings must be distinguished from ordinary generated statements.

sources.title: Create and use avatars
sources.use: User-controlled recording, permitted use and sharing; do not automate identity consent.

sources.title: Export responses
sources.use: Native export destinations differ from locally converted files.

sources.title: Download Gemini Apps data
sources.use: User-scoped Takeout exports can supplement backups but are not atomic live snapshots.

sources.title: Use Gemini Apps and generate files
sources.use: Chat files and temporary-chat restrictions; true file bytes need verification.

sources.title: Gemini Apps privacy hub
sources.use: Review data handling when adding account content storage; no promise of zero provider retention.

sources.title: Illustrated storybooks
sources.use: Structured pages, versions and reading/export workflows; text alone is insufficient.

sources.title: Deep Think transition
sources.use: The page describes replacement by Argon; detect deprecation rather than forcing legacy selectors.

sources.title: Connected Apps
sources.use: Connections, account constraints and revocation; not blanket permission for external side effects.

sources.title: Watermark settings
sources.use: Expose only observed provider settings, not watermark removal or provenance falsification.

sources.title: Import from other AI platforms
sources.use: Supported import workflows do not establish arbitrary lossless restore of Gemini resources.
